Use Tier 2: add an auxiliary two-step prediction objective to the existing GRURec, focusing on data_processing_and_feature_engineering, model_design, and training_evaluation. The plateau may reflect an overly narrow next-item learning signal in sparse histories; this is a hypothesis, since previous convolution and sampled-softmax experiments did not improve the reference. Predicting a second future purchase can encourage useful longer-range representations without adding another encoder or inference scorer.

Preserve the current history windows and primary targets, and construct auxiliary targets by shifting each window’s existing target array one position left, masking positions without a second observed future item. Score these auxiliary targets using the same causal GRU states, tied embeddings, learned bias, and score scale used for ordinary next-item prediction. Keep the primary eight-negative softplus loss unchanged and add 0.25 times the identically formulated auxiliary loss, using eight independently sampled uniform negatives with auxiliary-target collisions rejected. This is one atomic multitask experiment: retain the architecture, optimizer, sampling windows, dimensions, dropout, and training schedule, and introduce no auxiliary parameters or inference-time score combination.

Train exactly one model from scratch per category with training seed 42, retaining all four routes, supplied preprocessing-seed-0 splits, DATA_DIR=os.environ['GAGC_DATA_DIR'], trial-local artifacts, single-GPU execution, and the existing 200-epoch environment default. Verify auxiliary-target alignment and masking, finite loss for batches without eligible auxiliary positions, and prediction parity after checkpoint reload; the predictor writer must continue reconstructing the same GRURec and strictly loading one selected checkpoint per category. Preserve fixed validation with 200 users per category, 99 unique negatives, evaluation seed 42, identical validation/prediction preprocessing, and HR@10 checkpoint selection with NDCG@10 tie-breaking. Print the measured Final Validation Score and compare authoritative host macro HR@10 and category results against 0.5737, keeping all execution within the remaining shared budget and leaving hidden-test inference to the host.
